description.content: Play is the work and the language of the child. It is a natural part of a child’s daily development to engage in play. Pretend play is a way for kids to explore different identities, feelings, and experiences.

title: Milestone Mental Health - Child Emotional & Behavioral Issues

description.name: description
description.content: Parent-Child Interaction Therapy (PCIT) is an evidence-based therapeutic intervention for young children (ages 2-7) with emotional and behavioral challenges and their caregiver(s). Our therapists are also trained to utilize PCIT with older children (ages 8-11) using developmentally appropriate adaptations.

title: Milestone Mental Health - Social-Emotional Skill Building

description.name: description
description.content: Our therapists weave in social-emotional skill-building practices in individual or family therapy sessions through structured activities and/or in pretend play as these are often the skills that children with mental health difficulties struggle with the most.

description.name: description
description.content: Theraplay is an evidence-based therapeutic intervention for children, ages 0-12, who struggle with emotional or behavioral challenges and their caregiver(s).

title: Milestone Mental Health - Trauma-Focused Cognitive Behavioral Therapy

description.name: description
description.content: Trauma-Focused Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (TF-CBT) is an evidence-based therapeutic intervention for children/adolescents (ages 6-18) and their caregiver(s) that have experienced or been impacted by trauma, stress, or adversity.

title: Milestone Mental Health - Trauma-Informed Child-Parent Psychotherapy

description.name: description
description.content: Trauma-Informed Child-Parent Psychotherapy is an evidence-based therapeutic intervention for young children from birth through age seven and their caregivers.
